title: Makefile: header changes do not trigger recompilation
description:
The Makefile lists source files as dependencies for the library and test targets but not header files. Editing any wolfp11/*.h file does not cause recompilation. This is a latent correctness issue: a developer editing wp11_settings.h to change a compile-time constant will not see the effect until 'make clean'.

Fix: add automatic dependency generation via gcc -MMD -MP and include the generated .d files in the Makefile. Add comment explaining the pattern.
